bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
root="$(pwd -P)"
repo=seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot
target=7363a9139428a9c0cb7d244fb049be4c9ab9fede
base=221e3c39dd3096befbef79243875506822f4afb8
old_sha=d3922d37add83bda516be53fd21c22e40dcb1be5c4877a8e8a6becb1753c6104
stage=deploy/state/recruit-pr82-7363a913
localtag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
candidate=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:recruit-7363a913
rollback_tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-recruit-7363a913
test "$(gh api repos/$repo/pulls/82 --jq '.head.sha')" = "$target" || exit 52
test "$(gh api repos/$repo/pulls/81 --jq '.head.sha')" = "$base" || exit 53
for run in 46121165085 46121165057 46121165109; do
 test "$(gh run view "$run" -R "$repo" --json headSha,status,conclusion --jq '.headSha+" "+.status+" "+.conclusion')" = "$target completed success" || exit 54
done
test "$(gh api repos/$repo/actions/artifacts/15253917277 --jq '.workflow_run.head_sha')" = "$target" || exit 55
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
old_image="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$localtag")" = "$old_image"
live_sha="$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)"
case "$live_sha" in
 "$old_sha"|ab51d9db90226ce551b43154b2a1a89ba778bc9a7c54877e05615cdb28716326) ;;
 *) echo 'LIVE_BASELINE_NOT_INCLUDED' >&2; exit 51 ;;
esac
pg_before="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' deploy-postgres-1)"
ub_before="$(systemctl --user show -p MainPID --value gace-userbot-verify.service)"
test "$ub_before" != 0
test ! -e "$stage" || exit 56
mkdir -m 700 "$stage"
gh run download 46121165057 -R "$repo" -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$stage"
new_sha="$(sha256sum "$stage/gaybbs.mjs" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
migration_sha="$(sha256sum "$stage/backfillExistingRecruitmentCards.mjs" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
printf '%s\n' 'FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local' 'USER root' 'COPY --chown=node:node --chmod=600 gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs' 'COPY --chown=node:node --chmod=600 backfillExistingRecruitmentCards.mjs /app/backfillExistingRecruitmentCards.mjs' 'USER node' > "$stage/Dockerfile"
docker build --network none --pull=false -q -t "$candidate" -f "$stage/Dockerfile" "$stage"
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node "$candidate" --check /app/gaybbs.mjs
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node "$candidate" --check /app/backfillExistingRecruitmentCards.mjs
test "$(docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sha256sum "$candidate" /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$new_sha"
test "$(docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sha256sum "$candidate" /app/backfillExistingRecruitmentCards.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$migration_sha"
new_image="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$candidate")"
docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" config -q
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$old_image"
test "$(gh api repos/$repo/pulls/81 --jq '.head.sha')" = "$base" || exit 53
docker tag "$old_image" "$rollback_tag"
swapped=0
ok=0
cleanup(){
 rc=$?
 trap - EXIT
 if test "$swapped" = 1 && test "$ok" != 1; then
  docker tag "$rollback_tag" "$localtag"
  docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate gaybbs
  echo GAYBBS_ROLLBACK
 fi
 exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
docker tag "$candidate" "$localtag"
swapped=1
docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate gaybbs
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 24); do
 if docker logs --tail 300 deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -F 'GAYBBS_POLLING_READY' >/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi
 sleep 3
done
test "$ready" = 1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$new_image"
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$new_sha"
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/backfillExistingRecruitmentCards.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$migration_sha"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' deploy-postgres-1)" = "$pg_before"
test "$(systemctl --user show -p MainPID --value gace-userbot-verify.service)" = "$ub_before"
printf 'GAYBBS_SOURCE=%s\nGAYBBS_BUNDLE_SHA=%s\nGAYBBS_DEPLOY=PASS\n' "$target" "$new_sha"
ok=1
trap - EXIT
# Read-only inventory. Apply is a separate admitted request after checking results.
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/backfillExistingRecruitmentCards.mjs --dry-run
